source.title: Lieder und Gesänge mit Begleitung des Pianoforte : Op. 66. 15tes Liederheft
source.creator: Weber, Carl Maria von

reference.corrections: Tenore has two flats like the other parts, not three. Canto e Alto measure 4 rewritten as printed: G5 dotted quarter, G5 eighth and dotted-rhythm chords above a second voice G4 A4 Bb4 C5. Tenore measure 4 starts with a dotted quarter. Measure 5 ends with an eighth rest in every part (the upbeat completes it).
